tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i las byang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bzhugs so//

༄༅// bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag nag po la phyag 'tshal lo// lta ba'i dregs pa thu bo sder bcas rnams// g.yul ngor bsad pa'i khrag gis rab myos gar// bde chen sa la rnam par rtse ba'i lha// dbyings nas khros pa tshe bdag der btud nas// zla gsang rgyud sde nyal 'gro'i nying khu gang*// lcags sdig chos kyi bai ḍūr+yar chags pa// 'phrin las don kun bsgrub la mthu stobs gzi// 'bar ba'i zla nyi las 'gong 'di na ston// dkyil 'khor gsum las e thung la// bca' bzhi sems bskyed bsrung 'khor bsgom// bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad sgo dbye phyag /dam bca' byin dbab bshags pa dang*// mchod rdzas byin brlab ting 'dzin bsgom// 'byung brtsegs gzhal yas lha bskyed drang*// bzhugs gsol dbang phyag mchod bstod 'dzab// bshags pa bya rnams stod kyi las// sgrub chen gzhung bzhin bcas 'dug sems/ hūm̐ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// thugs kyi sras su mdzad du gsol// lan gsum bya la bsrung 'khor ni/ hūm̐ snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcur song*// lte bar bdag nyid zil gnon sku// 'jigs byed kī la ya sgrog pa'i// thugs las hūm̐ bcu rtsibs su 'phros// e a kro te ka /ya man+ta ka/ ka la ru pa hrīṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ steng du khro rgyal hūm̐ kā ra// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// tshangs pa'i snying zug steng gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ shar du khro rgyal bi dza ya// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// dri za'i snying zug shar gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

lho ru khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// gshin rje'i snying zug lho gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ nub tu khro rgyal rta mgrin che// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// klu dbang snying zug nub gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hūm̐ phaṭ/ byang du khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// gnod sbyin snying zug byang gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ṭa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ shar lhor khro rgyal dbyug sngon can// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// me lha'i snying zug me gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭ/ lho nub khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// srin po'i snying zug srin gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha a tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/ nub byang khro rgyal 'dod pa'i rgyal// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// rlung lha'i snying zug rlung gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha ṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar khro rgyal gsum las rgyal// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// dbang ldan snying zug dbang gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'og tu khro rgyal stobs po che// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// sa bdag snying zug 'og gdon 'joms// oṃ ma hā kro dha mahā ba la hūm̐ phaṭ/ bgegs bskrad bshos chang ting lo rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs byin/ hūm̐ yang gsang lha yi dur khrod gzhal yas 'dir// 'du ba'i dbang ldan las byed ma gtogs pa// bar chad 'byung po su yang gnas mi rung*// de bas ma thogs myur ba nyid du song*// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛ h+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ a+yai rings kyis bskrad mtshams bcad me'i/ /hūm̐ gshin rje gshed po khros pa'i me// steng 'og phyogs mtshams bar med pa// ye shes me dpung gcig gis bcad// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa zhugs su 'phro// oṃ badz+ra kro dha karma raṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mtshon cha 'chol ba'i mtshams bcad pa/ hūm̐/ steng yang mtshon cha'i bla bre la// 'og kyang mtshon cha'i sa gzhir bcas// bar snang mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrug /spu gri can ltar gtub cing snyol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha tik+ṣ+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ khro bo 'chol pa'i mtshams bcad pa/ /hūm̐ dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul phyir// nam mkha' khro bo rol pas bkang*// bar snang khro mo gtum mos gtams// sa gzhi khro sras 'chol bas khyab// oṃ mahā kro dha kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas gsang mtshams bcad pa ni/ /hūm̐ chos dbyings rnam dag skye ba med pa'i dbyings// ma bcos lhun grub bde ba chen po'i sku// phyag rgya zil gnon thugs rje'i 'phro 'du las// bgegs dang bar chad cang med rang bzhin mtshams// oṃ a e sa ma ye hūm̐/ brda sgo dbye nas phyag bya ba/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor gnyen po rnam par dag pa'i sku// sgo phyogs lhun grub ye shes gnas yul du// dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa'i brda sgo dbye// mnyam nyid dag pa'i tshul gyis brda phyag 'tshal// bla med sems kyi dam bca' ni/ /hūm̐ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang*// rang byin brlab pa'i thabs shes la brten nas// bde bar gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems gzung ngo*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a dra u pa ta yā mi// de nas dam rdzas byin dbab pa/ /hūm̐ ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i thugs rje las// byin rlabs kun 'byung rtags dang mtshan ma ston// dbang dang dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol// mthu phyung dam rdzas 'di la byin cig phob// sa ma ya hoḥ

sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐// de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ rang sems byang chub sems su ma 'byongs pas// snang tshad ye shes lags pa ngo ma shes// rig tshad dngos grub yin par brda ma 'phrod// de kun mi 'chab nongs pa'i sems kyis bshags// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya/ sogs pa'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ mchod rdzas byin brlab la bzhi las/ hūm̐ yaṃ raṃ khaṃ gis mchod rdzas thams cad sbyangs// oṃ las kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyur// āḥlas thams cad 'dod dgur snang ba'i char// hūm̐ las nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par 'bab// oṃ āḥhūm̐ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ hrī tha// nang mchod bdud rtsi byin brlab ni/ hūm̐ thod dbus rigs lnga snyoms zhugs bdud rtsi zhu// nyi bkab rta mgrin sbyor mtshams byang sems phab// bdag gi mtheb mdzub zla bas zag dang 'dres// mdangs dri ro bcud gter chen dpa' bos bsrung*// oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥswāhā/ muṃ khaṃ paṃ taṃ laṃ/ oṃ āḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī tha// gtor ma chen po byin brlabs pa/ /hūm̐ rlung me thod sgyed kā lir lnga gnyis zhu// oṃ las 'dod yon āḥlas zla bas bkab// hūm̐ las rdo rje phyed lter dkyil 'khor lha// bdud rtsi bkug gsol rjes chags dbyings phab dkrugs/ oṃ āḥmahā ba liṃ ta te dzo bhā liṃ ta bha ta gu ya sa ma ya swāhā// rak+ta rnam bzhi byin brlab ni/ /hūm̐ bhan+dha zla ba'i gdan dbus pad+ma ra// yongs gyur rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong can// nam mkha' khyab dbyings lbu ba'i gur nang du// gīrti dmar mo bha ga'i rak+ta 'beb// oṃ āḥm hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥ / ting 'dzin gsum las de bzhin nyid/ /hūm̐ skye med rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas// thugs rje rol pa'i bye brag ci bstan kyang*// gnyis med 'bras bu phyag rgya chen por rdzogs// snang stong gnyis med ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/

oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ// kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐ ngo bo nyid ni chos sku skye ba med// skye ba'i cho 'phrul snang la rang bzhin bral// yon tan ye shes mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// snying rje 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang la 'char// āḥdharma hri tu swa bhā wa bi shud+dho ྅ haṃ// rgyu'i ting 'dzin sgom pa ni/ hūm̐ sku ni sgyu ma'i phyag rgya cir yang snang*// gsung ni khro bo'i rngam sgra lnga dang ldan// thugs ni sna tshogs cho 'phrul mtshon cha bzhin// las kyi skabs kyis phye bas e ru shar// oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐// 'byung ba brtsegs mar gsal btab pa/ /e las e yaṃ maṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ chad// nam mkha' gru gsum rlung gzhu khrag mtsho zlum// gser gzhi gru bzhi thod pa'i lcags ri dang*// pad+ma dur khrod rdo ra me ris bskor// e yaṃ maṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ maṇ+ḍal hūm̐// de nas gzhal yas khang 'di 'drar/ hūm̐ mtha' dbus me klong sna tshogs rdo rjer bh+rūṃ// phyi bltas kun bzang rgyan bkod gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta dbus dang bcas pa babs mchod rten dbyibs// khyung gi tog mdzes nang bltas dur khrod khang*// ma them glang chen yas 'brug 'gram gnyis seng*// sgo ni stag gzig nyi zla'i rgya skar can// rusbal ka gdan lha chen brgyad kyi ka /gza' gzhu klu gdung tshangs lcam zhing gi thog /chu srin bad skor rgyu skar drwa mig can// nya sbrul zar tshags lha mo rgyu sogs brgyan// dbus gling mkhar dgu phyi e zla gam gsum// 'khor lo bcu gnyis rtsibs kha gru chad bzhi// khyams 'obs so gnyis mu ran drug cu ste// kun la gru gsum thod pa lcags kyi mkhar// bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe ka pā la bh+rūṃ// gtso bo 'khor bcas lha bskyed pa/ /hūm̐ e nyid e ka dza ṭī 'phro 'dus thim// rgyu med klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong*// lha chen phyogs skyong ma hes btegs pa'i khrir// 'khor lo rtsibs stong pad+ma zla nyi'i steng*// bcom ldan dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon sku// dug chen 'khyil 'dra mthing nag gar dgu'i nyams// sbom zhing gsus 'phyang yan lag rags la brjid// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi g.yon pa brkyang*// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag po'i zhal// gdug pa'i mche gtsigs klu gnyan sa bdag za// ljags bsgril sma ra ag tshoms smin ma ser// spyan dmar gsum gsum gzir gzigs khro gnyer bsdus// ral pa gshor po thod pa rigs lngas brgyan// g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje 'phen// g.yon gsum be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub mdzad// dregs pa'i mgo bcad snying bcas ga shar byas// glang lpags stod gsol zhing dkris stag sham can// khrag zhag phyag rgya drug dang sbrul gyis spras// gshog brgyangs 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug par rol// g.yon log sbyor yum pe tā li mthing nag

/snying bzung khrag gi mtsho brngub gzig sham can// g.yas su sgrol yum e ka dza ṭī sngo// ral gri g.yu spyang re lde'i smad g.yogs brgyan// g.yon du dbyings yum mu kha le dmar smug /khram 'debs nad rkyal ba lang ko bas dkris// gsum ka gtum sbeg dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// ral pa mun gtibs rngam pa'i gar gyis rol// ling tshe phyogs bzhir phyogs skyong pho mo'i gdan// phyag shar rdor ljang nag rdo rje snying 'phreng 'dzin/ ya lhor ma smug po 'khor lo tsit+ta bsnams// gnyis ka drag shul che la chas brgyad 'chang*// g.yon brkyang 'bar ba'i dbus na brjid par 'gying*// rus nub sbal rngam pa mi zan dmar ser la/ mche sder gnam lcags lto ba srid pa'i khyams// byang bya khyung dkar po gshog pa me dang mtshon// mchu sder rwa lcags gzi mig sbrul bzung za// mtshams bzhir phyogs skyong pho mo brdzi ba'i lha// seng me ge stag srin sbrul rlung khyung dbang gdong gshed po bzhi// rang 'dra'i yum bcas rusbal g.yang gzhi gsol// ce spyang la zhon ral gri snying 'phreng bzung*// zla gam mkhar nang gnyan klu sa bdag khrir// seng ge stag dang sbrul zhon las gshin gsum// tshe bdag rgyab dbu dgu khyung gsum stag gzig dom// dkar dmar mthing khro mdog nag bco brgyad phyag /'khor lo ral gri rdo rje rtse gsum mdung*// mda' dbyug rgya gram lcags kyu g.yas dgus bsnams// be con gtun shing zhags sbrul sdigs mdzub dang*// spu gri dgra sta g.yang gzhi tsit+ta g.yon// dbyings phyug rgyal mo dang rol zhabs brgyad bgrad// g.yas su 'chi bdag nag po chu srin gdong*// gdengs ka dgu g.yob smad sbrul rusbal gos// be con 'khor lo bzung yum dug hrul ma// g.yon du srog bdag dmar po mgo bcu pa// steng ma bya rog gzhan khro bse khrab gyon// khram shing 'khor lo 'dzin yum khrag 'jib ma// rtsibs dbus ya ma ra

shar mthing khrag mdog ma// myos byed lho 'bar ba ser po gsod byed ma// ār+ya nub dmar po srog len nag mo dang*// ral byang pa tshar dgu ljang kha ral gcig ma// yab rnams be con 'khor lo glang lpags bgos// yum rnams khram rkyal rusbal rlid bu gyon// g.yas phyogs pa'i shar gyi mdun zur dung mon seng mgo bla rkun ma// lcags mthing mon stag mgo g.yu yi ral can ma// bse dmar ser mon dred mgo tshe srog khrag ral can// gser ser mon khyung mgo snying 'byin mon mo ste// pho rnams s+t+wa gri tsit+ta glang chen lpags// mo rnams lcags kyu zhags thogs rusbal gos// g.yon phyogs pa'i shar gyi rgyab zur he le khyab nag pa mi gzan ma// nag po nag 'dzum med snying khrag dug 'thung ma// so 'dar nag 'phrig pa sha la gzer 'bebs ma// ral nag pa spyir bcings bdud mo khrag ral ma// bdud rnams khram zhags lpags pa'i go zu dang*// bdud mo spu gri mi snying rusbal lpags// gru bzhi'i steng bar 'og khang rab 'bring tha gsum gyi zla gshed du sgo logs g.yon gsum/ /be ba sa nag nor bu dge 'phel ser// 'joms byed ser nag phung byed re ma ti// dgu khri nag la rāk+sha glog 'phreng dmar// yak+ṣa gsod byed mthing nag tsā muṇ+ḍi// gtum po kun 'joms gnyis dkar ral gcig dmar// 'bar ma ti dang sbrul mgo kun 'dzin sngo// ngang pa stobs ser gyad stobs nag 'bar ma// phyag na be con 'khor lo chu srin gos// mo bzhi thal mdog khram rkyal mi lpags can// khyams 'obs bdud gsum rim du bskor ba phyogs mtshams su lcog brgyad brgyad yod pa'i shar dang mer nag khram thogs rta zhon brgyad// gshin rje lho srin be con 'khor thogs glang zhon brgyad// ma nub rlung mo nad nag rkyal zor thogs drel zhon brgyad// gnod byang dbang sbyin ral nag gri zhags thogs bya zhon brgyad// sgo bzhir dus bzhi'i bdag po khro rgyal bzhi

dkar ser dmar ljang*// dkar po snying 'byin mahā kā la dang*// yab rje nag po gnod sbyin dmar po rnams// ber gsol 'khor lo bskor cing thun khrag 'phen// g.yon du yum chen ro langs chen mo bzhi// phyag g.yas thams cad ro dbyug g.yon lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril bu 'dzin// phyi khyams gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu'i 'phrul// za gshed pho mo drug cu smug nag dur khrod na// rgyal chen phyogs skyong brtan ma mkha' 'gro dang*// gshan pa khrag skyug dregs pa kun gyis bskor// 'od zer lcags kyus spyan drangs pa/ /hūm̐ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku// gdan drangs gshegs su gsol rgyu ci yod kyang*// thugs rje 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid nas// drag po e yi dkyil 'khor chen po ru// bdud sder khros 'khrug rngam par chas bzhin pa'i// 'jam dpal tshe bdag rtsa ba gyad kyi lha// sprul pa las gshin bka' nyan 'khor bcas su// ye shes sgyu mar rol pas spyan 'dren no// e ka he dun ya ma rā tsa sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ bsgoms dang gnyis med bzhugs gsol ba/ hūm̐ dam tshig pa dang ye shes sems dpa' zhes// ma dag gnyis 'dzin snang bas gzung ba tsam// gdod nas mnyam nyid dbye ru mi 'tshal bas// chu la chu bzhag lta bur bzhugs su gsol// ya ma rā tsa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan// de la dbang bskur bya 'dod pas/ /ye nas sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'chang rgyal spyi gzugs yin mod kyang*// ma rtogs sems can thugs rjes bsgral ba'i phyir// khro bo rol pa'i nus mthus dbang bskur ro// oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ ha a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rgyas btab bo// dad cing mos pas phyag bya ba/ /hūm̐ lha yi rgyal po lha mchog gshin rje'i gshed// 'gro ba'i don mdzad 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag /yab yum sprul pa bka' nyan 'khor bcas la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// e ka he dun ya ma rā tsa sa ma ya nā mo bh+yo//

mchod pa 'bul ba bzhi las phyi/ /hūm̐ sna tshogs me tog 'phreng bas bcings pa ni// 'ja' tshon sna lnga bas kyang bkrag re mtshar// bdug pa spos kyi dud sprin gtib pa ni// dpag bsam yongs 'du bas kyang bsung re zhim// gsal byed mar me mdun du bdar ba ni// nyi ma zla ba bas kyang mdangs re gsal// tshangs pa'i dag byed gan+dhe sbreng ba ni// rgya mtsho chen po bas kyang gting re zab// zhim dgu'i zhal zas gtsang mar bshams pa ni// lha yi bdud rtsi bas kyang ro re bda'// rnga sil dung gling rol mo 'bul ba ni// dri za'i pi wang bas kyang sgra re snyan// phyag rgya gar 'chams mchod par sbyar ba ni// mtho ris zlos gar bas kyang blta re brod// 'dod pa lnga yi lha mo bsgrigs pa ni// 'chi med bu mo bas kyang snying re sdug /bla re 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan phye phur rnams// kun bzang mchod sprin bas kyang ya re mtshan// ral gri mda' mdung mtshon chas mchod pa ni// gshin rje'i 'dun sa bas kyang zhud re che// oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐// nang mchod sman raka gtor ma bsgreng*/ /hūm̐ rang byung gdod nas rnam dag rigs lnga'i rdzas// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i ra sa na// ye shes lnga las rang byung dug lnga'i sman// dam tshig bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ+-i ta pū dza hoḥ hūm̐ tshang mi 'dug pas blo ldan rnams la mnga' tshe 'brel ba gnang skyong yod pa zhu/ khenpo.kanam@gmail.com info@dharmadownload.net
